name: dsh-zhipu-provider
description: DSH plugin (dual-half): seeds the zhipu-coding-plan provider (Zhipu Coding Plan, OpenAI-compatible coding endpoint) into the llm-pi-ai user settings layer at boot, and ships a Web GUI usage pill (conversation.composer.dock) backed by /api/zhipu-usage/* — 5h-window/weekly credits plus the MCP monthly quota, fetched from open.bigmodel.cn with the Console key resolved via the DSH credential seam.
